ribbon-menu.$description: RibbonMenu: the commands of an application in tabs, each tab in named groups of large, medium and small commands.

rows.$description: How many medium or small commands stand one above the other in a group.

row-height.$description: The height of a row of commands, in both layouts, whatever stands in it: at least a small field, so the menu keeps its height from tab to tab.

compact-size.$description: Narrower than this, the menu shows a tab picker in place of its tabs and its commands in a single row.

indicator-inset.$description: How far the mark of the tab shown keeps from the tab's sides.

large.$description: A large command, and the button a group folds into when there is no room: the icon above the text, as high as the group. Its variant and size, and the look of a toggle that is on.

medium.$description: A medium command: the icon beside the text. Its variant and size, and the look of a toggle that is on.

small.$description: A small command, alone or in a row, and the "more" button of the simplified layout: the icon alone. Its variant and size, and the look of a toggle that is on.

more.$description: The button beside a group's name that opens more options of the group.

switch.$description: The button at the end of the commands that switches between the classic and the simplified layout.

scroll.$description: The buttons over the ends of the commands that scroll them, while there is more to scroll to.

picker.$description: The button that stands for the tabs in a compact menu: the tab shown, and a menu of the others.

gallery-open.$description: The button of a gallery that opens all of its choices: beside its row, or alone with the command's text when the gallery is small.

root.$description: The whole menu: the row of tabs above the commands.

reveal.$description: The strip a menu hidden automatically is, until it is opened (`hover`, `focus`).

frame.$description: The row of tabs and the commands (`floating`: opened over the page from the strip).

bar-start.$description: The app's own content at the start of the row of tabs.

bar-end.$description: The app's own content at the end of the row of tabs.

app.$description: The button before the tabs: under the pointer, pressed, focused by the keys.

quick.$description: The quick commands, in the row of tabs (`below`: under the commands).

tab.$description: A tab: under the pointer, pressed, shown, focused by the keys, of a context, disabled.

indicator.$description: The mark under the tab shown.

context-band.$description: The band over a tab of a context.

body.$description: The surface the commands of the tab shown stand on (`floating`: opened over the page from a tab).

stage.$description: Where the groups of the tab shown stand, and scroll when they do not fit.

panel.$description: The groups of one tab, in a row (`simple`: in the simplified layout).

group.$description: A group: its commands above its name.

commands.$description: The commands of a group: large ones as high as the group, medium and small ones in columns.

group-foot.$description: The row under the commands: the group's name, and the button beside it.

separator.$description: A line between commands of a group.

large-face.$description: What is pressed of a large command: the icon above the text.

large-arrow.$description: The arrow part of a large split command: only as high as its arrow, under the icon and the text.

large-icon.$description: The icon of a large command.

hint.$description: A key hint: the letters that press what it stands on.

drop.$description: The popup the button of a folded group opens: the group as it is.

gallery.$description: A gallery's row of choices and its button.

gallery-grid.$description: All the choices of a gallery, in the popup its button opens.

tile.$description: A choice of a gallery: under the pointer, pressed, chosen, focused by the keys, disabled.

tile-icon.$description: The glyph or the image of a choice.
